verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a S3-protocol compatible API for network volumes (direct file management without a Pod), plus runpodctl CLI for transferring files between local machine and Runpod, and network volumes for persistent shared storage across compute. This covers S3-compatible endpoints, transfer tooling, and cloud-storage-like sync in first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the S3 API and CLI transfer performance/reliability, and no explicit third-party cloud-storage sync (e.g., rclone/S3 client) walkthrough beyond docs.
